inlines.v: UNBAL'ANCED, adjective 1. Not balanced; not poised; not in equipoise. Let earth unbalanc'd from her orbit fly. 2. Not adjusted; not settled; not brought to an equality of debt and credit; as an unbalanced account. 3. Not restrained by equal power; as unbalanced parties.
